messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: unusual spike in external-tool/agent-call surfaces and structured JSON generators across hosted clusters. error-rate ↑, 95p latency ↑ 2.3x, queue depth growing. auto-throttle not yet triggered. paging oncall now.
maya: acked. paging in. looking at cluster metrics and tenant heatmap.
maya: quick snapshot — most traffic from two tenants in us-west-2, many concurrent 'agent-call' sequences that spawn structured JSON outputs. CPU on gpu-pool-8 at 88%, burst queue on inference-router-2.
jamal: on it. rolling up logs now. curious if this is new client behavior or a model regression.
edwina: adding mitigation proposal: 1) soft-shed agent/toolchain calls (reject with 429 after X second queue) 2) force fallback to plain-text output for best-effort routes 3) apply tenant-level short TTL quota (30s) for structured-output generation 4) enable routing to lower-capacity model variant for non-sso customers.
maya: +1 to those. prefer non-disruptive first: soft-shed (dequeue and 429) then fallback. want a targeted tenant cap before cluster-wide.
ops-bot: runbook snippet requested by maya:

```
# soft-shed agent calls on router
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/mitigate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"
  -d '{"action":"soft_shed","target":"agent_calls","threshold_ms":2000,"mode":"per-tenant"}'
```

jamal: executed soft-shed in per-tenant mode for the two hot tenants. response: 200. seeing immediate reduction in queue depth.
edwina: enabling structured-output fallback on edge routes (convert structured-json -> plaintext summary). patching route config now.

```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap route-overrides --type merge -p '{"data":{"structured_output_mode":"fallback_plain"}}'
```

ops-bot: configmap patched on clusters: us-west-2-a, us-west-2-b. rollout started.
maya: monitoring telemetry. 95p latency trending down. token cost per second reduced ~18%.
tori-support: compiling customer impact list. current affected tenants: acct-9923 (major), acct-1187 (medium), acct-2250 (small exploratory). preparing proactive notices.
jamal: noticed a few clients getting 429 when hitting the agent-call endpoint — expected with soft-shed. logs show retries from some clients causing repeated load. we should offer a short retry-window header in responses.
edwina: adding `Retry-After: 5` to 429 responses in mitigation patch.
ops-bot: mitigation updated; 429 now includes Retry-After: 5.
maya: handing off to edwina for next 45m. I'm going to sleep-monitor and will re-engage if SLOs deviate. edwina, you own customer comms and escalation.
edwina: ack. taking over. plan: 1) keep per-tenant soft-shed in place for 30m, 2) keep structured-output fallback until stable, 3) escalate to product if we need to widen tenant caps.

jamal: minor tweak — also enable a per-route rate limiter for `/v1/agent_call` at 60 rps global for now to protect control plane. applying.
ops-bot: rate-limiter applied: /v1/agent_call -> 60rps global. rule id rl-22733.
tori-support: drafted message for acct-9923: "We observed increased agent usage impacting latency. We've temporarily limited structured outputs and applied a short per-minute quota to stabilize. This may change some responses to simplified text or return 429 with a short retry window. We're monitoring and will follow up within 1 hour." want approval.
edwina: approve. please send.

ops-bot: support notification queued and sent to affected contacts for acct-9923, acct-1187, acct-2250.
maya: mid-runcheck — metrics holding. CPU down to 68% on gpu-pool-8, queue depth steady.
jamal: still seeing a small cohort of aggressive retries. propose adding a short token-bucket for retries per-client to reduce thundering herd.
edwina: go ahead and implement if low-risk.
jamal: token-bucket rule added: 3 retries / 30s per client for agent endpoints.
ops-bot: rule applied across ingress proxies.
tori-support: customers acknowledged receipt and glad to have updates. acct-9923 wants a post-incident writeup.
edwina: creating postmortem ticket: PM-4729. tagging product and devex for follow-up on SDK guidance to avoid unsafe retry loops.
maya: handing back to oncall rotation at 2273346200. final status before handoff: mitigations active, latency within SLO, impacted tenants under direct support liaison. escalate if recurrence.
edwina: final note — will start gradual relaxation after 30m observation window. prefer manual rollback to ensure no premature reopen.
ops-bot: METRICS: 95p latency: 210ms -> 120ms after mitigations. agent-call qdepth: 420 -> 35. token spend/sec: -18%.
maya: resolved for now. will file short incident summary and link PM-4729. thx team :thumbsup:
jamal: adding logs bundle to PM-4729 and flagging suspicious client behavior for abuse team.
edwina: thanks all. handing to support for follow-up comms. closing thread when PM is created.

incident-bot: NOTE: create-incident PM-4729 (postmortem) assigned to edwina, notify #product #devex #support.
